scores.notes: Compared the bowler-hatted man with a doctor's bag on the left pavement (the only Watson-like figure) to the man in a bowler with a bag being pulled through the door on the right: both have dark hair, a dark moustache and a similar youngish face and build.
Left Watson, seated in the train in a bowler, has a pale face with no visible moustache; right Watson in the doorway has a thick dark moustache and a fuller face. The moustache cue conflicts.
The seated Holmes by the fire and the Holmes lunging with the match by the bed both have dark wavy hair, a long narrow clean-shaven face and a lean build.

Compared the man standing behind Holmes in the hat scene (doctor's bag and bowler on the desk) with the seated Watson in the train: both have sandy-brown side-parted hair, a brown moustache and the same face shape and age.
